I need to identify the exact method that executes the SQL INSERT when a memo is saved, and explain how I determined which candidate code actually runs.

Three INSERT candidates exist across the SQLite, Postgres, and MySQL memo files. The default driver is SQLite, set by viper in cmd/memos/main.go. The execution chain begins at APIV1Service.CreateMemo and routes through Store.CreateMemo.

Store.CreateMemo delegates to the driver's CreateMemo. NewDBDriver selects sqlite.NewDB by default, so the concrete method is `(*DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. It executes the INSERT via `d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, stmt, args...)`.

I am checking whether `profile.Validate` reinforces the default SQLite driver setting.

The full determination chain is now clear.

The default driver is SQLite. `db.NewDBDriver` selects the SQLite implementation. `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`. The INSERT runs in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` via `d.db.QueryRowContext`. The three driver implementations are the multiple candidates. Tracing the call chain from `main.go` through `db.NewDBDriver` to the SQLite driver confirms the active path.

The API entry point is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, which delegates to `Store.CreateMemo` and then to the driver interface. The active candidate is `(*DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. The determination method is tracing the default `--driver` flag and the `viper` default `"sqlite"` through `db.NewDBDriver`'s switch to `sqlite.NewDB`, which eliminates the parallel `postgres` and `mysql` implementations.

h12.

**`(*DB).CreateMemo`** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`; **determination:** traced the default install path from `cmd/memos/main.go` (`viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`, so no `--driver` flag ⇒ `profile.Driver == "sqlite"`) through `store/db/db.go` `NewDBDriver`, whose `switch profile.Driver` selects `sqlite.NewDB` and not the parallel `postgres`/`mysql` drivers; then followed the memo-create call chain `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go`, which delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`) to the SQLite implementation, where the INSERT is built and executed via `d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, stmt, args...)` at lines 41–47.

The three competing INSERT implementations are the driver-specific `CreateMemo` methods in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`; only the SQLite one is reachable on a default install because driver selection happens once at startup in `NewDBDriver`, not per request.
